title: Factory Factory Factory: Human Judgement at Digitale Leute Summit
abstract: Two days at Digitale Leute Summit in Cologne, one recurring question: where does human judgement come in, and where do we just trust? Notes from my 60-minute deep dive on agentic SDLC, the dark factory debate, and the people I met.
